usage:
  ruledger derive  <rule set>
  ruledger diff    <test design> <rule set>
  ruledger observe <rule set>

  --plugins <folder>   where the vocabularies are        (default 'plugin')
  --rulesets <folder>  where fetched components are read (default 'component')
  --out <file>         where derive writes    (default beside the rule set)
  --from <file>        the test design to carry the choices of (default --out)
  --write              amend the test design diff was given
  --states <n>         states to visit before stopping    (default 3000)
  --candidates <n>     candidate inputs to try in a state (default 10000)
  --outcomes <n>       outcomes to follow for one input   (default 64)

        versions are not compared on the same state

'rulealize restore <rule set>' fills the folders this reads.
